claim: Reading of the VHDL (3.01.09): locked 7FFD writes are ignored without remapping, NextReg $08 bit 7 can only unlock, and 48K timing (NextReg $03) does not stop 7FFD/1FFD decoding.
limit: Confirmed on the N-Go board (Issue 2-compatible clone, core 3.03.00): locked writes ignored, NextReg $08 bit 7 only unlocks (nxsuite M02); 7FFD still pages at 48K timing (XT4). 1FFD at 48K timing not measured (the +3 ports were trapped).

evidence.text: VHDL reading for core 3.01.09, not confirmed on hardware.
N-Go board (Issue 2-compatible clone), core 3.03.00 (nxsuite M02): a 7FFD write while locked changed no MMU slot; $08 bit 7 = 0 kept the lock, 1 unlocked it.
N-Go board (Issue 2-compatible clone), core 3.03.00 (nxsuite XT4): at 48K machine timing a 7FFD write still paged MMU 6 / 7 ($06 / $07).
